title: BreakingChanges
description: Array of breaking changes extracted from a library migration guide

title.description: Short human-readable title matching the guide section heading

description.description: What changed, why it breaks, and any relevant context

pattern.description: JavaScript-compatible regex string (no surrounding slashes) to grep/AST-search old API usage in source files

selector.description: Optional CSS or XPath selector if detection is DOM-based

note.description: Plain-English description of what to search for

before.description: Code snippet using the OLD (Express 4) API

after.description: Code snippet using the NEW (Express 5) API

notes.description: Optional caveats, edge cases, or additional migration steps

source.description: Section heading or URL anchor in the migration guide where this change is documented
